changes.text: Clinician Bathing Demonstrations: 128 Vicon captures (257,000 frames) of 3 clinicians bathing 6 subjects while wearing 65-taxel PPS TactileGloves on both hands; release announced in the RSS 2026 paper, no link yet.
Force-Vision (Li et al., ICLR 2024): 150,000 frames of a knitted 16x16 pressure glove paired with webcam video over 89 articulated tools; a data zip is linked on Google Drive, license not stated.

WiTac: per-finger contact tokens from Sharpa Wave fingertip deformation, hand pose and wrist views, pretrained on about 300 h of SharpaDex; raises GR00T N1.7 from 37.5% to 66.3% on four tasks; no code release stated.
PTLD: tactile state estimator for an Allegro hand with 368 Xela uSkin taxels, distilled from real rollouts of a simulation-trained privileged policy; its code link returns 404.

TF²-Steering: tactile residual steering of a flow-matching action expert on two Sharpa hands, pretrained with T-Rex and FTP-1-Sharpa touch; 71.5% average progress success on six real tasks; no code release.
FBI: visuotactile shortcut policy for a Shadow Hand, trained in simulation and run with 148 RunesKee force sensors in the real world; the paper points to code on its site, which has none.

T-WLA: tactile editor that corrects action chunks between RGB updates on Linker Hand L6 fingertip arrays, with its tactile encoder pretrained on EgoTouch and evaluated on Tachin; code on GitHub without a license file.

ReTouch: pi0-based VLA for an XHand (120 three-axis taxels per finger) that predicts and refines future touch online; 83.6 average score on seven tasks; code and its 900-demonstration XHT-Dataset not released.
ViTacFormer: cross-attention visuo-tactile policy with tactile prediction on pre-release Sharpa Wave hands; Apache-2.0 code public, no checkpoint.
HOPE: per-vertex MANO contact and pressure in kPa from monocular video, trained and tested on OpenTouch glove pressure (vertex contact F1 0.680, MAE 1.23 kPa); code public, no checkpoint.
Talos electrician conduit and subpanel sample: a Zenodo lite mirror (one episode, LeRobot metadata and spec sheet, 7.2 MB, CC BY-NC 4.0) added to sources.
